questions.question:
Select the option that will make the second pair analogous to the first pair.

Gregor Mendel : Biology :: Antoine Lavoisier : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Gregor Mendel : Biology

Gregor Mendel is a **biologist**. He is famous for his work on pea plants, discovered the fundamental** laws of inheritance**. 

Similarly,

Antoine Lavoisier : ?

Antoine Lavoisier is a father of** Chemistry**. He discovered the law of **conservation of mass.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"option (2)".**

questions.question: 'Minute' is related to 'Hour' in the same way as 'Inch’ is related to '_________'.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 
• The time period of **60 minutes is a hour.**

Similarly,

 
• **The unit length of 12 inches is Foot.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Foot".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters / number of consonants / vowels in the word)

Spider : Web :: Horse : ?
questions.solution: **Logic :** Animal : Shelter So, • **Spider** creates a **web** for shelter. Similarly, • **Horse** is kept in a **stable**. Hence, **"Stable"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/ vowels in the word.)

Episode : Series :: Chapter : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Part of a Whole Relationship**.

Here,

Episode : Series → **Episode** is a part of a **Series**.

Similarly,

Chapter : Book → **Chapter** is a part of a **Book**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.solution:

Peso : Chile → Peso is the currency of Chile.

Similarly,

Ringgit :** Malaysia** → Ringgit is the currency of Malaysia.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

Ten : Decade :: Thousand : _______
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Decade is the period of ten years. So, ten is related to decade.

Similarly, 

Millennium is the period of thousand years. So, thousand is related to millennium.

Hence, **"Millennium"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option in which the words share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of words.

Cat ∶ Mew ∶∶ ? : ?
questions.solution:
The logic is:

Cat ∶ Mew → The sound made by cat is mew.

Similarly,

Duck ∶ Quack → The sound made by duck is quack.

Hence, ‘**Duck ∶ Quack**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In each of the following questions, select the related word from the given alternatives.

Procession : Route : : Earth : ?
questions.solution:
Procession proceeds on a certain route.

Similarly, Earth revolves around the Sun in its orbit.

Hence, Orbit is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the related word from the given alternatives.

Vitamin C : Scurvy ∷ Vitamin B1 : ?
questions.solution:
Scurvy is a deficiency disease caused due to the lack of Vitamin C. Similarly, lack of Vitamin B1 causes Beriberi disease.

Hence, Beriberi is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

Electricity : Galvanometer :: Atmospheric Pressure : ______
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :

__
 
• **Electric currents** is measured by an instrument called **Galvanometer**.

Similarly,

 
• **Atmospheric pressure** is measured by an instrument called **Baro**meter.

Hence, **"Barometer"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Barometer → It is an instrument used to measure atmospheric pressure.
 
• Osmometer → It is an instrument used to measure the osmolality of aqueous samples.
 
• Sphygmomanometer → It is an instrument used to measure blood pressure.
 
• Hydrometer → It is an instrument used to measure the relative density of liquids that is, the ratio of the density of the liquid to the density of water.
